# Payding

> Smart currency exchange rate alerts for global earners. Get notified when your local payout is higher than the day you were paid.

Payding is an information-only tool for freelancers and remote workers paid in foreign currency. Users log payments manually; Payding tracks mid-market exchange rates (Frankfurter API) and emails alerts when it's a good time to convert. We do not hold funds, connect to banks, or execute transfers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, how it works, and payment logging.
- [About](/about): Why Payding exists and who it's for.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides on timing foreign payouts and currency strategy.
